purpose: Define denominators, events, ownership, and publication rules without inventing a local baseline or target.
claim_boundary: Participant-authored operating contract only. It defines role types, records, pause conditions, and evidence needed for later professional work. It does not name real institutions, certify products, authorize treatment, approve construction, or claim field performance.

metrics.formula: sum eligible elapsed time / closed repair cases
metrics.audit_role: independent reviewer appropriate to metric and public claim
metrics.refresh_cycle: define after lawful pilot and sample review
metrics.privacy_boundary: asset/service event only; no unnecessary identity or continuous personal trajectory
quality_checks: missing state not represented as zero
metrics.publication_rule: publish only aggregated, caveated values after denominator and review are complete
